weapons.name: M1A Loaded
weapons.source_note: Specification table: 'Barrel | 22" NM Medium Weight, 6-Groove Carbon Steel, 1:11'. Product text: 'a National Match tuned 4.5-lb. competition trigger, 22" 1:11"-twist premium barrel'. 1 turn in 11 in = 279.4 mm, 6 grooves.

weapons.name: SAINT Edge 5.56 NATO
weapons.source_note: Specification table: 'Barrel | 16" LW Profile CMV, Melonite®, 1:8'. Product text: 'A premium 16" 1:8"-twist Melonite®-coated barrel stabilizes a wide variety of bullet weights.' 1 turn in 8 in = 203.2 mm. Groove count not stated.

weapons.name: AUG Assault Rifle
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer text on the AUG SA page (which covers AUG SA ARMY and AUG A3 SA variants): 'The cold hammer forged and hard chrome plated barrel with a twist rate 1 in 9” guarantees high reliability.' 1 turn in 9 in = 228.6 mm. Steyr Arms USA lists a separate 14.5 in accessory barrel at 1:7 and 9x19 mm kits at 1:10; the standard 5.56x45 mm AUG barrel is 1 in 9.

weapons.name: AUG A3 Assault Rifle
weapons.source_note: Same manufacturer statement on the AUG SA page, whose model list includes the AUG A3 SA SE and AUG A3 SA POLICE: 'The cold hammer forged and hard chrome plated barrel with a twist rate 1 in 9” guarantees high reliability.' 1 turn in 9 in = 228.6 mm.

weapons.name: Edge semi-auto
weapons.source_note: STI manufacturer barrel specification in the BARRELS section: 'The rifling is 1 in 16 twist and has 6 lands and grooves.' The same section lists the barrel calibers as '.355, 9mm, .38 super, .400, .40 S&W, .450, .45 ACP', so the .40 S&W bull barrel used by the Edge (an STI 2011 double-stack, listed in this catalog) is 1 turn in 16 in = 406.4 mm, 6 lands and grooves.

weapons.name: Cougar 8000 .40 Semi-auto Pistol
weapons.source_note: Stoeger-hosted Cougar manual, 'Rifling, Pitch: R.H., 6 grooves. Pitch: Caliber 9mmx19 (9 mm Parabellum) and 9mmx21IMI: 250 mm (9.8 in.). Caliber .40 S&W: 400 mm (15.7 in.). Caliber .45 ACP and .357 SIG: 406 mm (16 in.).' The .40 S&W value is 400 mm, right-hand, 6 grooves. The manufacturer's own metric figure is used, not a conversion of a rounded inch figure.

weapons.name: Cougar 8000 .45 Semi-auto Pistol
weapons.source_note: Stoeger-hosted Cougar manual, 'Rifling, Pitch: R.H., 6 grooves. Pitch: ... Caliber .45 ACP and .357 SIG: 406 mm (16 in.).' The .45 ACP value is 406 mm, right-hand, 6 grooves.

weapons.name: 10/22 Tactical 16.12" threaded barrel, flash suppressor
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer spec sheet for the 10/22 Tactical Model 31184: 'Model Number: 31184', 'Barrel Length 16.12"', 'Thread Pattern 1/2"-28', 'Twist 1:16" RH', 'Grooves 6', and 'Threaded barrel with 1/2"-28 thread pattern capped with Ruger® flash suppressor.' 1 turn in 16 in = 406.4 mm, 6 grooves.

weapons.name: 10/22 Takedown takedown carbine, 18.5" barrel, backpack case
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer spec sheet for the 10/22 Takedown Model 32010: 'Takedown Model', 'Model Number: 32010', 'Barrel Length 18.50"', 'Twist 1:16" RH', 'Grooves 6', with the description 'Easy takedown enables quick separation of the barrel from the action'. 1 turn in 16 in = 406.4 mm, 6 grooves.

weapons.name: 22 Charger pistol, 10" heavy barrel, bipod, scope rail
weapons.source_note: Archived manufacturer spec sheet for the original 22 Charger Model 4901 (catalog number CHR22-10, the 10 in heavy-barrel Charger supplied with bipod and scope rail): 'Catalog Number: CHR22-10', 'Model Number: 4901', 'Caliber: .22 LR', 'Barrel Length: 10.00"', 'Twist: 1:16" RH', 'Grooves: 6'. 1 turn in 16 in = 406.4 mm, 6 grooves.

weapons.name: American Rifle Predator 20" heavy barrel, synthetic stock, .308
weapons.source_note: Archived manufacturer spec sheet for the Ruger American Rifle Predator Model 26918: 'Caliber: 308 Win', 'Barrel Length 22"', 'Twist 1:10" RH', 'Grooves 5'. All .308 Win Predator models on the manufacturer spec pages (26918, 16954, 6974) state 1:10" RH, so the .308 Win Predator twist is 1 turn in 10 in = 254.0 mm, 5 grooves. The worklist barrel length (20 in) differs from the manufacturer's 22 in for this model number, but the twist is stated for the .308 Win Predator.

weapons.name: LCR .357 Mag, polymer frame, 1.87" barrel
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer spec sheet for the LCR Model 5450 (.357 Mag, 1.87 in barrel): 'Model Number: 5450', 'Caliber: 357 Mag', 'Barrel Length 1.87"', 'Twist 1:16" RH', 'Grooves 6'. 1 turn in 16 in = 406.4 mm, 6 grooves.

weapons.name: Redhawk large-frame DA/SA, 4.2" barrel
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer spec sheet for the Redhawk Model 5059 (.357 Mag, 4.20 in barrel): 'Model Number: 5059', 'Caliber: 357 Mag', 'Barrel Length 4.20"', 'Twist 1:18.75" RH', 'Grooves 5'. 1 turn in 18.75 in = 476.25 mm, 5 grooves. The .44 Mag Redhawk models use 1:20; this .357 Mag model is 1:18.75.
